market.summary: Large caps rose but the broad market fell: the Nifty gained 0.6% to 25,291 on FMCG and bank buying while the Smallcap 100 lost 1.1% and only about a third of NIFTY 500 stocks rose. Foreign investors bought for a fifth straight day by the exchange's provisional figures (about Rs 4,865 Cr net) while domestic funds sold. That split hurt the two small-cap holdings (Sejal Glass, Bhageria), which closed below cost today; the hotel and music names held.

points.text: Sensex 82,104.79 (+0.63%), Nifty 25,291.10 (+0.58%); Midcap 100 -0.51%, Smallcap 100 -1.10%; FMCG +1.87% led, Metal -1.50% and Realty -1.34% lagged.
Provisional cash flows 16 Nov: FIIs +Rs 4,864.7 Cr, DIIs -Rs 3,519.1 Cr; FIIs net buyers about Rs 38,200 Cr over the last 5 sessions.
Brent January futures about $95.6 at 15:37 IST, slightly lower as Hormuz shipments recover; MCX gold -1.4%, silver -3.8%.

market.watch: Whether small caps stabilise (two holdings are on exit signals); Nvidia results later this week for global tech mood.

SEJALLTD.summary: Sejal Glass fell 4.1% to Rs 867.60 on a weak small-cap day, below your average cost of Rs 884.13. The trade had passed +1R (stop moved to cost), and this close is below cost and the 10 EMA, so the plan says exit the whole position. This evening (18:29 IST) the company filed an intimation about the demise of a person named in the file as 'CVG'; the PDF could not be opened from this check and no news report was found, so who it is and any effect is not verified.

points.text: Close Rs 867.60 vs Rs 904.90; cost Rs 884.13, 10 EMA Rs 881.94, 20 EMA Rs 855.00; 1-month -10.2% vs +5.0% for Nifty India Manufacturing.
NSE filing 16 Nov 18:29 IST: 'Demise of CVG - Intimation' (content not verified).
14 Nov: business transfer agreement signed to buy Magnumtuff India's glass business for Rs 40.80 Cr, closing by 30 Nov.
The monthly RSI shows a bearish divergence (engine momentum check).

SEJALLTD.watch: Plan says exit (close below cost). Read the 16 Nov filing: if it concerns a key promoter or director, expect more volatility.
